claims.title: Lv1 close exchange: first hit is not automatic retreat
claims.korean_coaching: W 시작 다리우스가 비슷한 체력으로 근접전을 이어 갈 수 있다면, 암베사에게 먼저 한 대 맞았다는 이유만으로 자리를 줄 필요는 없다. 평타·W를 이어 붙일 수 있는지 보고 맞받아친다. 암베사가 Q 끝거리만 맞히고 빠지면 따라가며 더 맞지 않는다.

conditions.level: Both Lv1, no imminent unequal level-up
conditions.items: Comparable starting-item strength; no completed item; Blade vs Shield and potions must be checked, not silently equated
conditions.health: Both initially high and broadly comparable HP, or only a small first-hit deficit; no validated numerical HP cutoff
conditions.resources: Darius enough mana for learned spell; Ambessa energy and learned spell/recast availability checked
conditions.distance: Already close enough to AA/W or can walk there without eating repeated Q edge poke
conditions.minions: No large hostile wave, turret exposure, or unknown early multi-enemy intervention
conditions.escape: Count remaining ability-triggered dashes and Flash/Ghost; no assumption that W slow disables dash

counterexamples: Ambessa Q1/Q2 sweet spots land while Darius cannot AA; this is poke, not a sustained close fight.
Large existing HP deficit, Ignite/Bone Plating/Electrocute differences, hostile minion focus, or a level2 race reverse the decision.
Ambessa exits with remaining dash/Flash; no continued contact means no guaranteed stacks or duel win.
modern_patch_compatibility_risks: No measured first-hit duel, replay, numerical simulation, or patch16.20 controlled test collected.
Heywil targets16.3; old Phase Rush mentions are stale relative to current guide.
claims.adoptable_scope: Adopt as conditional contest/no automatic concession, not a verified absolute win-after-first-hit statement.

claims.title: Use cooldown advantage to hold last-hit space
claims.korean_coaching: 암베사가 1레벨 스킬과 후퇴 돌진을 쓴 뒤에는 아군 막타 자리 옆을 잡는다. 걸어서 평타·W가 닿는 CS 진입을 압박하고, 암베사가 빠지면 CS와 자리 이득을 챙긴다. 도망친 암베사를 잡으러 적 웨이브 깊이 들어가지는 않는다.

conditions.items: Comparable starting-item strength; no completed item; Blade vs Shield and potions must be checked, not silently equated
conditions.health: Both initially high and broadly comparable HP, or only a small first-hit deficit; no validated numerical HP cutoff
conditions.resources: Darius enough mana for learned spell; Ambessa energy and learned spell/recast availability checked

claims.title: Q-start Ambessa can trade without accepting the brawl
claims.korean_coaching: 암베사 Q 시작이면 Q 가장자리 견제와 두 번째 Q를 먼저 본다. Q1이 적에게 맞으면 Q2가 열리므로, 첫 돌진을 봤다고 도주기가 끝난 것은 아니다. 평타가 닿지 않는 견제를 억지로 장기전으로 바꾸려 하지 않는다.

claims.title: Starting skills must change the call
claims.korean_coaching: 다리우스 Q 시작은 바깥날 적중 여부가 핵심이고, W 시작은 가까운 평타 교환을 이어 붙일 때 강점을 쓴다. E 시작에는 Q 피해·회복과 W 강화 공격이 없으므로 같은 맞딜 판단을 복사하지 않는다. 암베사 W 시작은 보호막과 강화 반격, E 시작은 둔화와 돌진 뒤 추가 타격을 따로 본다.

claims.title: Later pull-first is not a reliable chase
claims.korean_coaching: 2~3레벨 이후 암베사 스킬이 남아 있으면 E부터 걸었다고 추격이 보장되지는 않는다. 걸어서 평타·W가 닿는 상황에서는 E를 남겨 이탈에 대응하고, 돌진을 다 썼거나 크게 손해를 강요할 창인지 먼저 본다.

claims.title: Repeat trading/sustain requires actual outer Q hits
claims.korean_coaching: Q를 배운 뒤 바깥날을 맞혀 회복하고 교환을 끊을 수 있을 때만 반복 교환의 회복 이득을 계산한다. 암베사 돌진에 Q 자루가 맞거나 빗나가면 그 회복을 기대하지 않는다. W 시작 1레벨에는 Q 회복이 없다.

conditions.items: Comparable starting-item strength; no completed item; Blade vs Shield and potions must be checked, not silently equated
conditions.health: Missing HP exists; Q heal scales with missing HP and actually landing blade
conditions.resources: Repeated Darius spell use costs mana; Ambessa gains energy from empowered autos
conditions.distance: Already close enough to AA/W or can walk there without eating repeated Q edge poke
conditions.minions: No large hostile wave, turret exposure, or unknown early multi-enemy intervention
conditions.escape: Ambessa can use dash to deny blade

W shield, starting item/rune/potion sustain, low mana and later Ambessa R healing invalidate simple regen comparison.

official_mechanisms.Darius: P stacks up to5, increased AD at5; W slow; Q blade heal and stack, handle no heal/no stack; E pull. See S1 raw JSON data.Darius.passive/spells.
official_mechanisms.Ambessa: Ability use triggers step; empowered AA returns energy. Q hit any enemy unlocksQ2. W shield + empowered response if blocks nonminion damage. E slow + second strike after step. See S2 raw JSON data.Ambessa.passive/spells.

guide_knowledge: Heywil specifically advocates Lv1 Q-edge poke without taking autos; later W inward to deny blade and E slow as final escape. Darius is dangerous if allowed AA initiation.
Federals Ambessa row advocates exploiting long early cooldowns and warns pull-first plus Ghost can still fail to catch.
Both guides support a threat dependent on actual contact and cooldowns; neither provides controlled16.20 first-hit outcome proof.

calculations.limitations: Base regeneration only; no items/runes/growth/potions/Q or R healing, not a matchup outcome calculation.

AI_interpretation: C1 first-hit alone does not concede space is an inference from source-backed AA initiation danger, not direct measured win evidence.
C2 position/CS rights is a narrow local translation of cooldown and contact threat, not source-verbatim macro proof.
C4 rare starts differ mechanically; unsupported to assert all starting-skill pairs favor Darius.
not_established: Guaranteed win after Ambessa first AA or first spell
Guaranteed 5 stacks, kill or chase from passive existence
Exact health breakpoint, damage rotation ordering, or all9 Lv1 skill-pair duel ranking
